Pearl Abyss and CCP Games are having a publisher sale on Steam


Pearl Abyss and CCP Games are starting their very first massive publisher sale via Steam. You’ll be able to get game packages for Black Desert SEA at discounted prices, also purchasable through the official website.



The “Pearl Abyss X CCP Games Publisher Sale” offers discounts on various game products, with Players able to get up to 90% discounts on game passes and packages for Black Desert SEA and EVE Online until November 2. Shadow Arena is also offering a discount on various hero skins via the in-game Shop until October 28.

reference_summary: Pearl Abyss dan CCP Games menganjurkan jualan penerbit pertama mereka di Steam, menawarkan diskaun sehingga 90% untuk pakej permainan untuk Black Desert SEA dan EVE Online sehingga 2 November. Shadow Arena juga menawarkan diskaun untuk kulit wira sehingga 28 Oktober. Selain itu, Pearl Abyss sedang menjalankan jualan tambahan Black Desert di tapak web rasminya sehingga 3 November, dengan diskaun sehingga 90% untuk pakej web. Untuk maklumat lanjut, lawati tapak web rasmi setiap permainan yang mengambil bahagian.
